predictions.selection_reason: malformed payload input -> try-catch wrapper -> changes error propagation behavior for decode failures
predictions.source_summary: jwtString parameter passed to verify function, which may contain malformed JWT tokens from external sources
predictions.sink_summary: callback function that propagates errors to application-level error handling
predictions.guard_summary: Previous signature verification (jws.verify) validates cryptographic integrity but not payload structure; try-catch now handles decode errors that were previously uncaught
predictions.risk_pattern: Malformed JWT payloads that pass signature verification but fail JSON parsing now have errors caught and propagated instead of potentially causing unhandled exceptions
enclosing_conditions: After successful signature verification (jws.verify returns true)
predictions.context_summary: The try-catch wraps payload decoding after signature validation, changing error propagation behavior for structurally invalid but cryptographically valid tokens
unresolved_facts: Specific error types thrown by jws.decode for malformed payloads
Whether malformed payloads that pass signature check can be exploited for security impact beyond error handling changes
